says: 0162 records main's merge queue as one pull request per group, up to 3 groups building, ALLGREEN and a 60-minute check timeout, but the live ruleset now merges up to 3 per group, groups HEADGREEN and waits 180 minutes.
proof: gh api repos/kamp-us/tea-fabrika/rulesets/26683281 on 2026-11-18 printed max_entries_to_build 3, max_entries_to_merge 3, grouping_strategy HEADGREEN, check_response_timeout_minutes 180, against 0162 lines 150 to 152: 'at most 1 to merge', 'ALLGREEN', '60 minutes'. During the sev0 max_entries_to_build had also drifted to 2 and was set back to 3 on the owner's yes.
cost: A lead that reads 0162 to judge a landing expects one pull request per queue group and a group that must be all green; under HEADGREEN a group lands on its head's checks, so two changes can merge together on one green run without either being tested alone. The record and the ruleset no longer say the same thing, and the ruleset is the owner's to set.
